newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Arab body to finance Tunisian olive oil project.
newsitem.headline: Arab body to finance Tunisian olive oil project.

text.p: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development AAAID will participate in the financing of a high-capacity refinery for olive oil in Tunisia, Agriculture Ministry officials said.

They said the convention was signed last Friday with AAAID which will subscribe for 25 percent of the six million dinar capital of the new firm to be set up. The project's total cost was estimated at 12 million dinars.

The refinery is to be set up in Agareb, near the coastal city of Sfax, Tunisia's main olive area. It is expected to enter into production by the end of 1996 with a yearly output of 100 tonnes of olive oil and olive-pomace oil, 10 tonnes of soap, and 10 tonnes of glycerol.
The majority shareholder is a private firm, Agro-Zitex.
Tunisia is one of the world's leading producers and exporters of olive oil.

The Arab League's Khartoum-based AAAID was established in 1976 to contribute to secure food self-sufficiency in the Arab world. It has 15 members and as of the end of 1995 had loaned 84 million Kuwaiti dinars in agricultural projects in Arab countries.
